Without --list-kinds, use 'object <kind> fields' to list fields for a specific kind.
With --list-kinds, output object kinds for the current seat (planner/doer membrane).
Use --all-kinds for the full registered catalog (admin break-glass).

Examples: zqk object backlog_item fields

  List seat-scoped kinds
  zqk object fields --list-kinds
  List kinds as JSON
  zqk object fields --list-kinds --format json
  Full catalog
  zqk object fields --list-kinds --all-kinds

Usage:
  zqk object fields [flags]

Flags:
      --all-kinds[=true|false]          Show full registered kind catalog (bypass planner/doer discovery membrane)
      --filterable[=true|false]         Show only filterable fields
      --format string                   Output format: table, json, yaml (default "table")
      --groupable[=true|false]          Show only groupable fields
      --list-kinds[=true|false]         List all object kinds (instead of listing fields for a kind)
      --sortable[=true|false]           Show only sortable fields
      --specialized-only[=true|false]   Show only specialized fields (exclude common fields)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal[=true|false]         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
